pictures.title: The Lake
pictures.alt: Benji, Bunny, Bruno, Fiona and Sunny look across the lake at clouds shaped like rabbit ears.

pictures.title: Ollie’s Dinner
pictures.alt: The five friends face Ollie the otter, who offers them a large fish in his landing net beside the lake.

pictures.title: Jumping Practice
pictures.alt: The five friends watch Freddie leap from a shore rock into the lake while Dotty coaches him in the air.

image_changes.alt: Freddie is half submerged in the lake, facing the five friends, with Dotty hovering and facing them too.

pictures.title: The Old Hut
pictures.alt: The five friends arrive at an empty old fishing hut and a boat on the lakeshore at sunset.

pictures.title: Dinner by the Fire
pictures.alt: The five friends share dinner around a wooden table beside a warm fire inside the old hut.

pictures.title: The Meeting Begins
pictures.alt: The old stag addresses a large gathering of forest animals beside the lake and the old hut.

pictures.title: Logan’s Idea
pictures.alt: Logan the beaver raises his paw to offer an idea while the old stag and forest animals listen.

pictures.title: Everyone Wants to Help
pictures.alt: The forest animals raise their paws and wings to volunteer to help the old stag.

pictures.title: Silence
pictures.alt: The forest animals lower their heads and look at the ground in silence beside the old stag.

pictures.title: Benji’s Plan
pictures.alt: Benji presents a forest map to the gathered animals. The stream on the map flows into the lake.
